summary: INI round-trip fix reviewed and approved. escapeIniValue() in LocalizationWriter.php correctly encodes backslash first to avoid double-encoding, then double-quote, newline, carriage-return. Unescape order in LocalizationTranslator.php correctly reverses: \n→\n, \r→\r, \"→", \\→\. INI_SCANNER_RAW prevents PHP from coercing boolean-like strings. TranslatorSpecialCharsTest.php covers both special-char round-trip and 'Yes' regression. No architecture or security concerns.
